name: Citizenship by Investment (CIU)

requirements.blocker_text: Non-refundable contribution to the Sustainable Island State Contribution fund starting at US$250,000 for a single applicant, US$300,000 or US$350,000 for larger family sizes, plus US$50,000-$75,000 per additional dependant.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying non-refundable SISC contribution.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Purchase of at least US$400,000 in a government-approved real estate development, resaleable after a 7-year holding period.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase a qualifying share in an approved development and hold for 7 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Purchase of a private condominium unit for at least US$400,000, or a single-family private home for at least US$800,000, resaleable after the required holding period.
Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Non-refundable contribution of at least US$250,000 to a government-approved Public Benefit project.
requirements.fix_path: Make the qualifying Public Benefit contribution.

requirements.blocker_text: Main applicant must be at least 18 years old.

evidence_required.document: Due diligence application and fee (US$10,000 main applicant, US$7,500 per dependant 16+)
Proof of qualifying investment (contribution receipt or property title/escrow)

sources.title: Citizenship by Investment Unit, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- Citizenship by Investment: Your Gateway to St Kitts and Nevis: SISC tiers ($250k/$300k/$350k plus $50k-$75k per dependant), Developer's Real Estate ($400k, 7-year resale restriction), Private Home Sale (condo $400k / single-family $800k), Public Benefit ($250k), due diligence fees ($10k main applicant, $7,500 per dependant 16+)
Citizenship by Investment Unit -- Application Process: no mandatory minimum physical presence to acquire or maintain citizenship under the current rules

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. Per-group age requirements set to hard: false (formality-only checks, consistent with the Antigua CBI precedent) so the route can remain 'published' on the strength of its investment-amount hard requirements, which ARE tier-1 sourced directly from the CIU's own gateway page. IMPORTANT / TIME-SENSITIVE: as of this build, the CIU Executive Chairman has publicly signalled planned 2026 reforms introducing broader 'genuine-link' requirements (structured physical presence, meaningful economic activity, long-term social/cultural/philanthropic engagement) plus a new 'Innovation Pathway' and 'Priority One' concierge service -- per IMI Daily, these are PLANNED BUT NOT YET ENACTED, with no specific day-count or effective-date figure published (unlike Antigua's specific 5-day/30-day CBI physical-presence amendment found earlier this session). This route is modelled on the CURRENT rule (no mandatory residency to acquire or maintain citizenship) and should be re-verified once the reform is enacted, since it may add a hard physical-presence requirement not reflected here.
